sources.location: ftp://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2016/04/PXD003550/MaxQ_search_txt_proteom.zip (txt/parameters.txt, summary.txt, proteinGroups.txt read by HTTP range)

claims.evidence: 75 files in PRIDE list: 72 RAW (each claimed once) + 3 MaxQuant txt zips (not data files). All entries list PXD003550.

claims.value: P<g>_<r>.raw = proteome; TF<g><r>.raw = secretome; <g>_<r>.raw = peptidome (g=1-6, r=1-4)
claims.evidence: summary.txt raw-file lists of the three separate MaxQuant searches (proteome, secretome, peptidome zips) name exactly these files.

claims.value: 3 donors x 2 oxygen conditions x 4 replicates x 3 compartments = 72
claims.evidence: Paper: ASC12, ASC21, ASC23 in normoxia and hypoxia, quadruplicate biological replicates of secretome, peptidome and proteome. Replicate number taken from the file-name suffix (inferred).

claims.value: odd groups 20% O2 normoxia; even groups 1% O2 hypoxia
claims.evidence: INFERRED, not stated in deposit. Proteome proteinGroups LFQ intensities: hypoxia-responsive proteins (LDHA, PGK1, ENO1, SLC2A1, BNIP3L, PLOD2, HK2, LOX, P4HA1/2) are consistently higher in groups 2, 4, 6 than 1, 3, 5. Paper confirms 20% vs 1% O2.

INFERRED. Group pairs follow the normoxia/hypoxia alternation and Y-chromosome proteins (RPS4Y1, DDX3Y) appear only in groups 3 and 4. Mapping to ASC12/ASC21/ASC23 is not recoverable from the deposit.

claims.value: male for donorB; not available otherwise
claims.evidence: INFERRED from detection of RPS4Y1 and DDX3Y only in donorB runs; absence in other donors is not proof of female, so left not available.

claims.value: Homo sapiens; adipose tissue; mesenchymal stem cell of adipose tissue
claims.evidence: Human adipose-derived stem cells (CL:0002570 in PRIDE sample attributes).
Methods: QExactive Plus, up to 12 precursors for HCD fragmentation. PRIDE lists Q Exactive; paper is more specific.
Trypsin 0.5 ug, overnight 37 C (protocol); MaxQuant special AAs KR.
parameters.txt MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm. Precursor tolerance not recorded in parameters.txt: not available.
sampleProcessingProtocol: TCEP reduction; chloroacetamide alkylation (no suitable PRIDE/MS term found; left not available).
Donor age, health status and ancestry are not given in the deposit or paper.
